title: Components and Props
description: Learn how to create reusable components and pass data between them using props.
longDescription: Components are the heart of React. In this module you'll master functional components, props, advanced patterns like render props, and the art of composing small pieces into complex interfaces. You'll also learn conditional rendering and list rendering with keys.
whatYouLearn: Create and export functional components using function and arrow syntax
Pass data between components using props and destructuring
Use advanced prop patterns including default values, spread, and children
Compose components together to build complex layouts and UIs
Render UI conditionally using ternary operators and logical &&
Render arrays of elements with map() and assign stable unique keys
